question: According to the 2024 Revised criteria for diagnosis and staging of Alzheimer’s disease, which of the following statements is most accurate regarding biomarkers used for diagnosis and staging of Alzheimer’s disease?

options.text: An abnormal Core 2 biomarker alone is sufficient to establish the initial biological diagnosis of Alzheimer’s disease in most clinical settings.
Core 1 biomarkers include amyloid PET, CSF Aβ42/40 ratio, CSF p-tau181/ Aβ42 ratio, CSF t-tau/ Aβ42 ratio, and accurate plasma assays such as plasma p-tau217.

CSF total tau elevation alone is a Core 2 biomarker and is recommended as the preferred standalone test for biological staging.
